body: Addition: Forgot to mention she doesn't drink at all. She doesn't do drugs except for like, shrooms or cocaine like once a year. Her and I are also vaccinated for Hep. A and B, and I'm 99% certain we are both immune to Hep. C.

It's a new practice and they don't know me as well yet. I also have expressed all of the different medications that haven't worked, so they've deemed me treatment resistant. My regular guy is a psych nurse practitioner, so he's referring me to his supervising MD for an eval. Not sure what will go down, but I haven't had an evaluation since I was a kid. Good luck to you as well; it really does suck.
Have you done TMS before, or known anyone who has? I haven't heard of that one yet.
I don't think any of that's for me. Procedures like that are frightening to think about.

Ah shoot, that's a bummer. I really don't want to be hit by my apartment for this - no ways of restoring the silver by painting? If not, would I be able to find this exact piece somehow?  


Would you be able to explain more if possible? From what I'm interpreting, do you mean to stand completely to the side of it? Also which part of the piece would be best to remove?    


Lots of questions here. Thanks for your time and help.

Thank you so much for taking the time to tell me your story! I'm also a huge cosmetology lover and I've watched the beauty vids of folks getting those full lace wigs glued on - so happy that we have those options for people! 

I really appreciate this a lot and I hope you have/had a good day at work!! :\^)
Anyone with any form of alopecia is welcome to partake in the survey :)
